_comment: What gets published: one list of packages for the pipeline and the app.
The app reads `app`, `symbol` and `app_detail` through `maps.json`; its own
table (`skifahrer/rikimaps`, `MapPiece.swift`) must match, a test guards both.
key         file stem (`presovsky-terrain.zip`) and key in `maps.json`
app         package name in the app
symbol      SF Symbol the app draws it with
app_detail  one line under the name in the app
description one line for the log, `contents.json` and the catalog
sources     whose data it is, keys of `credits.json`
suffixes    fallback when the manifest is unreadable: file name endings
regenerate  key that builds it alone (`Map · Regenerate region layer`)
part_of     package it also travels in
legacy      former keys; their old files on Drive are removed on publish
Order is the order in the app. A package dropped from here goes to `retired`,
whose files (key and legacy names) are deleted on Drive.

packages.app_detail: Cartography, waymarked trails and landscape, with water, boundaries, roads, railways, settlements and points
packages.description: the whole OSM cartography – areas, lines, labels, waymarked trails and the offline search index

packages.app_detail: Hillshading and 3D terrain, from the height model
packages.description: terrain height as terrarium tiles (raster .pmtiles) – the client draws hillshading and 3D terrain from it

packages.app_detail: Contour lines from the height model
packages.description: contour lines from the height model (.pmtiles)

packages.app_detail: Cliffs and rock areas, from the terrain's slope
packages.description: rock areas from the slope of the height model or from hillshading (.pmtiles)

packages.app_detail: Roads, paths, ferries and lifts with their limits, house numbers for search, and routing
packages.description: the OSM road network – motorways to steps, ferries and lifts (railways are in `railways`), with road limits, house-numbered addresses and the signed routing network the phone routes on (.pmtiles)
OSM point features – springs, caves, lookouts, monuments (.pmtiles)

packages.app_detail: State, region, district and municipality, with names
packages.description: OSM boundaries of state, region, district and municipality, with the names of those areas (.pmtiles)

packages.app_detail: Rivers, lakes, reservoirs and the sea, with names
packages.description: OSM rivers, streams, lakes, reservoirs and the sea, with their names (.pmtiles)

packages.app_detail: Railways, trams, metros and cable cars – open, planned or gone – with stations and routes
packages.description: every OSM railway and cable car including those under construction, planned and abandoned, named stations, line signs and the track network the phone routes trains on (.pmtiles)

packages.app_detail: Military sites, historic places, mines and adits, embankments, and everything abandoned or disused
packages.description: OSM military sites, historic places and listed monuments, mines, shafts, adits and quarries, embankments and dykes, and everything abandoned or disused – as points, lines and areas (.pmtiles)

packages.app_detail: Every building with its floor area and name, and the places they make up
packages.description: every OSM building with floor area in m², name, kind, levels and address, and place names from city to hamlet (.pmtiles)

packages.app_detail: Articles, read from a place you tap
packages.description: Wikipedia articles for the region's objects: articles.ndjson + index.json
